selection.selection_reason: Applied prospectively frozen deterministic development rule; see decision checks. No final benchmark results existed at selection.
selection.control_rationale: All three fixed families evaluated on final benchmarks regardless of selection. Old unaveragedepoch4 isolates average-versus-endpoint for old data; old-versus-expanded averages compare the whole expansion recipe, not purecoverage atfixedtokens. Only selected primary has the prespecified efficacy claim; secondary intervals remain exploratory/unadjusted.

validation_excluded_sensitivity.status: Prespecified before any current-study full5000 model outputs
validation_excluded_sensitivity.scope: Secondary sensitivity excludes the1500 questions used for current-study candidate validation. The remaining3500 have historical use, so this is NOT an untouched/independent test. It reduces direct current-candidate validation reuse without repairing all historical adaptivity. Original primary5000 and reservedOOD criteria unchanged.
